arStrings.szText: And yet, you have kept your humanity. Impressive, but I warn you, the Prime Evils are not to be trifled with, even as echoes in the nightmares of the dead.
Which brings me to our next task—Sankekur, disgraced pontiff of the Zakarum. It appears his Black Tomb was opened recently. “Desecrated,” according to these accounts, though it was far from sacred.
I suspect Sankekur might be drawn there, to Hawezar...perhaps with yet another splinter that must be pulled free.
